# Operation Cockpit Report Template

Use this template when a common foundation slice needs a completion report that
separates state, work, review access, action ledger, and continuation state.
Keep identity and access separate for every reviewable artifact.

## Current State

- outcome:
- outcome classification: completed / partial_completed / needs_user_decision / blocked_by_true_stop_condition / handoff_required
- active artifact:
- branch / HEAD:
- health:
- Handoff Gate:
